Epic free games). - **GOG** — DRM-free library with cloud-save sync. - **⬇ Cross-store Download Manager** — one view of all downloads + installed library, live progress, background + shade notifications, launch / verified uninstall. **🔒 Security & your store accounts** - Third-party sign-ins (not affiliated with the stores) — **use at your own risk**. - **Credentials redacted from logs** — signed URLs, OAuth codes, GOG secret / refresh-token, account IDs — in logcat and shareable files. **🧰 Bundled Start-menu utilities** - **[Banner File Manager](https://github.com/The412Banner/banner-file-manager)** *(dual-pane split view, Open-as-admin, native Win32 copy)*, **AIO Graphics Test**, **Game Controller Test**; `.lnk` "Start in" working-directory support. **🎛️ Interface & in-game overlay** - **Jetpack Compose** UI with an icon-led drawer; your theme recolours the whole app *and* the in-game drawer. - **16 themes** + HSV custom-accent picker. - **Big Picture mode** — Compose couch launcher, full D-pad navigation, rails to games / settings / features, per-game spec chips, Community Configs. - In-game overlay drawer + Task Manager (works on any renderer); Controls split into **Touch / Mouse / Vibration / Gyro** sub-tabs. - **File Manager with Favorites** — multi-select + bulk ops, fast same-volume moves, archive extract (zip / 7z / tar), search / sort, grid + compact views; doubles as the universal import picker. - **Performance HUD — FOUR overlay styles** (Classic / GameHub / GameNative-style + the new **[Fusion](https://github.com/The412Banner/FusionHUD)** HUD) on one shared FPS source + **cross-vendor, device-complete metrics** (FPS + 1%/0.1%/0.01% lows / frame time / per-core CPU-GPU load & temp / RAM / VRAM / swap / net / battery / power), **real graphics-API detection** (`D3D11·DXVK` / `D3D12·VKD3D` / `Vulkan` / `Zink`), temperature danger colours + °C/°F, long-press lock, and a one-tap **diagnostics export**. *(Fusion is also a [standalone open-source library](https://github.com/The412Banner/FusionHUD) other projects can drop in.)* - **FEX runtime indicator** — live arm64ec vs x86-64, translator, and unixlib vs DLL. **📥 Builds & distribution** - Three flavors (standard / PuBG / Ludashi), optimized release builds, AOSP-testkey signed, GitHub Actions CI + tagged releases.
## ✨ What's New in 2.8.1 2.8.1 collects **everything merged since 2.8** — the work that piled up while the Virtual Controller Pro PR ([#156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)) finished up. Grouped by area: ### 🎛️ In-game HUD & overlays - **New Fusion HUD** — a **fourth** performance overlay with a clean MangoHud-style look and **five tap-cyclable sizes** (Full / Tiles / Pill / Minimal / Mega), per-metric toggle chips, an FPS decimal and **1% / 0.1% / 0.01% lows**, a subtle clock, and per-core CPU + full system info in Mega. - 🧩 **The Fusion HUD is also open-sourced as a standalone, drop-in library for other projects → [github.com/The412Banner/FusionHUD](https://github.com/The412Banner/FusionHUD)** — any Winlator / Wine-on-Android fork can add it without re-implementing the sysfs/procfs plumbing (GPL-3.0, with a full [technical write-up of how it reads every metric](https://github.com/The412Banner/FusionHUD/blob/main/docs/FUSION_HUD.md)). - **Real graphics-API detection** — the HUD now shows what the game *actually* runs: **`D3D11 · DXVK`**, **`D3D12 · VKD3D`**, native **`Vulkan`**, or **`OpenGL` / `Zink`** — no more labeling a native-Vulkan game as DXVK. - **Cross-vendor metrics** — GPU load, GPU clock, CPU/GPU temperatures and VRAM now read across **Adreno · Mali · PowerVR · Xclipse · Qualcomm / MediaTek / Exynos**, not just Adreno; a metric a device doesn't expose simply shows "—". - **Export HUD diagnostics** — one tap saves a sensor report to your Downloads (each metric's resolved source, or the paths it tried) — send it in and we can add coverage for your device. - **Lock-in-place** on all four HUDs (long-press), plus temperature **danger colours** and a **°C / °F** toggle. ### 🌐 Community Configs — smarter matching & fuller round-trip - **Match by Steam appId** — configs resolve to the right game by its appId first, so renamed or oddly-named shortcuts stop matching the wrong game; a **"Which game is this?"** picker handles genuine ties, remembered per shortcut ([#167](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/167)). - **A shared config now restores far more of your setup** — the entire **HUD layout** (all styles incl. Fusion), **motion-aim**, **refresh cap**, **custom startup services**, **frame-gen model**, **upscaler** and **vibration** all travel now (previously dropped on export). - **Big Picture** gains the full Community Configs experience with complete controller/D-pad navigation. ### 🎨 Graphics, drivers & frame-gen - **Driver-source management** — add / remove / toggle your own adrenotools driver feeds, with the **MTR** and **WinNative** driver lists combined and auto-updating ([#160](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/160)). - **In-game refresh-rate unlock** — pick **90 / 120 / 144 Hz** from the in-game drawer where the panel and layer support it (a from-scratch RandR implementation). - **bionic-fg shader pool** (models 2 & 3, live model chips) and a **Xiaomi / HyperOS** frame-gen fix. - **bionic-fg is temporarily grayed out** while it's proven correct after repeated false-positive "working" reports — **use lsfg-vk** for frame generation for now; it returns once verified. ### 🚀 Startup, import & files - **Custom per-service startup** — a new startup mode where you pick exactly which services launch (winebus / winehid / …), per game ([#168](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/168)). - **Smart Game Import** — auto-naming, Steam cover-art + appId identification, missing-component recommendations, and an editable **Game Details** page. - **Drive-letter fix + games-folder bulk import** — add a whole folder of games at once; drive letters assigned per storage volume so SD-card games stop clashing. - **File Manager overhaul** — multi-select + bulk ops, instant same-volume moves, archive extract (zip / 7z / tar), search / sort / hidden files, grid + compact views. - New containers now start with **Motion Aim off** by default. ### ⌨️ Input & UX - **Compose env-vars editor** — a shared editor with a DLL-override toggle, editable dropdowns and collapsible chip groups. - **Cursor-to-Touch fix** + RTS-style touch gestures. ### 🛡️ Stability - **ASurfaceTransaction null-guard hardening** and a **game-name mangling fix**. > **⏳ Coming next — 2.9:** the **Virtual Controller Pro** update (PR [#156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)) is waiting on its final fixes before merging, and **2.9 will follow in the coming days**. 2.8.1 exists to get everything above into your hands now rather than have it keep waiting on the PR.
Previously in 2.8 — gyroscope motion aim, rebuilt Big Picture, PC-accurate vibration ### 🎯 Gyroscope — motion aim Aim by **tilting your device** — gyro drives the right stick, left stick or the mouse, in **Rate** or **Tilt-to-Aim** mode, with Hold-or-Toggle activation, device-level drift calibration, an adjustable activator (L1 / L2 / R1 / R3 / Always On) plus sensitivity / deadzone / smoothing / axis invert, and settings saved per container and per game. *Modeled on [WinNative](https://github.com/WinNative-Emu/WinNative)'s rate-mode gyro — thank you.* ### 📺 Big Picture — rebuilt from scratch A full Compose rebuild — a fluid couch launcher with direct rails to games / settings / features, real per-game spec chips, no background music, and D-pad navigation fixed throughout. ### 🎮 PC-accurate controller vibration Dual-motor output (strong + weak driven independently), per-container mode and intensity, and a `winebus` duration patch so sustained rumble actually sustains — across Proton 10 and 11, arm64ec and x86-64. *Originates from [GameNative](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative) #1214 via [TideGear](https://github.com/TideGear/GameHub-Vibration-Fix)'s port and #91, adopted with permission.* *Full 2.8 notes: [Bannerlator 2.8 release](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.8).*
## 🌐 Community — thank you 🙏 Everything you've shared **directly to Bannerlator's own Community Config repo** now adds up to:

   

And because the in-app browser **also merges the BannerHub catalog**, the full set you can browse and one-tap-apply *inside the app* is bigger still — thousands of games and configs. **370 games** and **466 configs** shared straight to Bannerlator by the community — and thousands more usable in-app once the BannerHub catalog is merged in. All of it growing. Every config you share, every game you add, every account that joins makes this better for the next person. **This project grows *only* because of the community's support and participation — thank you.** - 📦 **Bannerlator config repo** — [github.com/The412Banner/bannerlator-game-configs](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerlator-game-configs) - 📦 **BannerHub catalog** (also browsable in-app) — [github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-game-configs](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-game-configs) - 🌐 **Browse online** — [the412banner.github.io/bannerlator-game-configs](https://the412banner.github.io/bannerlator-game-configs/) ## 📥 Downloads | Variant | File | |---|---| | **Standard** | `Bannerlator-2.8.1-standard.apk` | | **PUBG** | `Bannerlator-2.8.1-pubg.apk` | | **Ludashi** | `Bannerlator-2.8.1-ludashi.apk` | > ℹ️ **Updating in-app?** 2.8.1 is **entirely app-side** — the standard APK covers everything. There's **no ImageFS reinstall**: your containers, themes, custom accent, per-game settings and control colours all carry over. Just install over 2.8. ## 📖 Guides - 🎨 **[Graphics wrappers & drivers — which one should I use? →](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/blob/main/docs/graphics-wrappers-guide.md)** — what a wrapper actually does, a **pick-by-GPU table** (Adreno / Mali / Xclipse / PowerVR), and every built-in driver + catalog wrapper explained. - 🎯 **[Gyroscope (motion aim) — the complete guide →](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/blob/main/docs/gyro-controls-guide.md)** — Rate vs Tilt to Aim, which target to pick, Hold vs Toggle, tuning, drift calibration and troubleshooting. - 🌐 **[Community Configs — plain-English guide →](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/blob/main/docs/community-configs-guide.md)** — browsing, applying and sharing per-game setups, and the optional account.
🙏 Credits — click to expand: everyone this build stands on - **[WinNative](https://github.com/WinNative-Emu/WinNative)** — the reference for **gyroscope (motion aim)** (rate-mode sensor→stick pipeline), and the **MTR / WinNative Drivers** feed now combined into driver-source management. GPL-3.0, same as this project. Thank you. - **[TideGear](https://github.com/TideGear/GameHub-Vibration-Fix)** — the **PC-accurate controller vibration** this build's rumble is built on: the feature port (carrying [GameNative](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative) #1214 forward) and the preload-free `winebus.so` rumble-duration patch (#91). Adopted with permission. - **[leegao](https://github.com/leegao)** — the Mali BCn transcode layer (`bcn_layer`) and DX12 **compat layer** behind the "Wrapper + compat + bcn" driver. - **[GameNative](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative)** — the engine behind the DX12 toggle; Bannerlator's HUD, present path, FPS-limiter and SurfaceFlinger colour work build on GameNative's foundations, and the vibration feature originates from GameNative #1214. - **[WinlatorMali](https://github.com/GunaCharanTeja/WinlatorMali) (GunaCharanTeja / Charan)** — the **Wrapper Version Manager** is modeled on WinlatorMali's graphics-driver manager; several catalog wrappers come from WinlatorMali too (credited in-app). - **[BrunoSX](https://github.com/brunodev85)** — the bundled **[Banner File Manager](https://github.com/The412Banner/banner-file-manager)** is our fork of BrunoSX's [Winlator File Manager](https://github.com/brunodev85/wfm) (MIT). - **Community reports & requests** — including [@Innersargento](https://github.com/Innersargento) ([#160](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/160) — driver sources) and the many device reports that drove the cross-vendor HUD work. Thank you. - **The wider stack** — built on the Winlator → cmod → Star Bionic lineage ([brunodev85](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator), [coffincolors](https://github.com/coffincolors/winlator), [Pipetto-crypto](https://github.com/Pipetto-crypto/winlator), [star-emu](https://github.com/star-emu/star)) with DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEXCore, [JavaSteam](https://github.com/Longi94/JavaSteam), and wrappers credited to their upstreams. Full attribution in the [repo README](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator#-credits).
## 🔗 Notes - **⚠️ On a 2.9 pre-release?** 2.8.1 (versionCode 50) is offered to you as an update, but it **does not include Virtual Controller Pro (PR #156)** — updating **removes those controller setups**. If you want to keep them, **don't update — wait for 2.9** (coming shortly), which finalizes and restores that feature. Otherwise 2.8.1 is the stable line with this cycle's newest work. - **bionic-fg frame generation** is temporarily non-selectable while it's proven correct — **use lsfg-vk** for now; it returns once verified. - The **Mali DX12** driver remains **experimental and opt-in** — inert unless you select it; Qualcomm/Adreno devices are unaffected. - **Gyroscope motion aim** needs a device with a gyroscope; on devices without one the gyro controls simply stay inert. - Nothing about your existing containers or settings changes on update — install over 2.8.

releases.name: Bannerlator 2.9-pre4
releases.body: # Bannerlator 2.9-pre4 — test build > ### ⚠️ This is a pre-release, not a stable build > It exists so the work below can get real testing on real devices. **Expect rough edges.** The headline feature — the rebuilt virtual controls editor — is **in-progress work from an open pull request. It is now Ready for review, but has not had a full review or a CI-verified merge yet.** > > - **Stable users are not affected.** `2.8` remains the Latest release; nobody is offered this unless they ask for it. > - **Already on 2.9-pre1/pre2/pre3?** This build carries the **same versionCode (49)** so it installs straight over them — but for that reason the in-app updater will **not** offer it to you automatically. Grab the APK below. > - **Coming from 2.8?** Settings → enable **"Include pre-releases"** in the updater, or just sideload. > - **If it misbehaves, install [2.8](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.8) back over the top.** It's app-side only, so nothing about your containers is at risk either way. > - **Please report what you find** — that's the entire point of this build. [Open an issue](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/new) with logs where you can. Like the last several releases this is **entirely app-side** — **no ImageFS reinstall**. Containers, themes, custom accent and per-game settings all carry over. Install straight over 2.8 or any earlier pre-release. ## 🔁 What changed since 2.9-pre3 pre3 was cut this morning; `main` has moved a long way since — **six merges** of new work now sit under the controls editor. This is the first test build to carry all of it together. ### 📁 A completely overhauled File Manager - **Multi-select** — long-press to select, then Copy / Cut / Delete a whole batch at once. - **Moves are instant within a drive** — cutting a game folder inside internal storage no longer copies every byte; it relinks. Moving *across* to an SD card still copies, as it must. - **Paste asks before it clobbers** — Overwrite, Merge (for folders), or Keep both, instead of silently making a `Game (1)` copy. Dropping an updated game folder onto an existing one finally updates it in place. - **Extract archives** — `.zip`, `.7z`, `.tar` and its compressed forms, straight from the file list into a new folder. - **Grid view + compact rows**, filter-this-folder **search**, **sort** by name/date/size, a **hidden-files** toggle, and **free space** shown in the bar. - The path bar now shows the **current folder name**, with the full path below it. ### 🎮 Add a whole games folder at once The **+** button now offers **Add games folder** beside *Add game EXE*. Point it at the folder that holds all your games and it scans each one for its executable, names it, pulls its cover art, and shows you everything it found to confirm before adding — with a **Change** option on any game whose executable it wasn't sure about. An **SD-card badge** marks games stored on removable storage in both grid and list views. ### 🎯 Smarter game names Auto-detected names no longer lose words from the middle — a folder called *Game Controller Test* is named exactly that, not "Controller Test". Adding a game through the File Manager's **Add to Shortcuts** now names it and fetches art the same way the **+** button does. ### 🗂️ Storage & drives - **SD/USB games stop eating drive letters** — a container now maps one drive per storage *device* instead of one per game, so a large SD library no longer runs out of letters. - New containers get sensible per-volume default drives. ### ⚙️ Defaults & hardening - **New containers start with Motion Aim (gyro) off** — it's opt-in now rather than on by default. - Defensive null-guards across the SurfaceFlinger and GL-native scanout renderers (a stability hardening; the default Vulkan renderer is unaffected). ## 🎮 Controls editor — the headline feature *(by [@arro000](https://github.com/arro000))* The whole on-screen controls editor has been rebuilt in Compose, replacing the old Fragment/XML interface, with a large set of new capabilities: - **New control types** — Dynamic Stick, Mouse Area, Button Grid, Expandable Button, Android Keyboard. - **A real editing UI** — Compose toolbar, visual control-type picker, sliding settings panel. - **Per-element tuning** — dead zones, sensitivity, hold bindings, detection-area styling, grid cell shapes. - **Better bindings** — category-filtered selector, multi-key combos, presets, custom icons (PNG/SVG, themed to your accent). - **Control groups**, **reference background images**, **live in-game profile editing**, and a **versioned ICPx** import/export format with legacy `.icp` compatibility. - Since pre3: per-device controller edge tracking, per-source pulses, opt-in Button Grid multitouch, and custom-icon rendering fixes. > ⚠️ **This is still the part that most needs testing.** It is a very large change to the input system. Please exercise your existing control profiles and report anything that regressed — especially profiles created in an older version. ## 🐞 Known issues - **Occasional ANR during input** — the UI thread can briefly block on a socket write. **Pre-existing** (reproduces on 2.8), listed so it's not a surprise. - **FPS limiter + frame generation at low caps** — a cap near 30 with generation on can drop generated frames. A cap of 60 behaves correctly. - **Frame-gen models 1–4 are experimental** and not quality-proven. Default (model 0) is unchanged from 2.8. - The controls editor is **unmerged work under review** — treat anything it does as provisional. ## 📥 Downloads | Variant | File | |---|---| | **Standard** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre4-standard.apk` | | **PUBG** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre4-pubg.apk` | | **Ludashi** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre4-ludashi.apk` | > ℹ️ **On an earlier pre-release already?** Same versionCode, so the in-app updater won't prompt you — download directly and install over the top. **On 2.8?** Turn on **"Include pre-releases"** in the updater, or sideload. Either way this build is **entirely app-side**: no ImageFS reinstall, and your containers, themes, accent, per-game settings and control colours all carry over. ## 🙏 Credits - **[@arro000](https://github.com/arro000)** — the entire virtual controls editor rebuild ([#156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)): the Compose editor, new control types, per-element tuning, control groups, background images, live in-game profile editing, the ICPx format, and the controller-input polish in this build. - **[@Devaspe](https://github.com/Devaspe)** — continued testing of the pre-release line.

releases.name: Bannerlator 2.9-pre3
releases.body: # Bannerlator 2.9-pre3 — test build > ### ⚠️ This is a pre-release, not a stable build > It exists so the work below can get real testing on real devices. **Expect rough edges.** The headline feature — the rebuilt virtual controls editor — is still **in-progress work from an open pull request that hasn't been merged or fully reviewed yet**. > > - **Stable users are not affected.** `2.8` remains the Latest release; nobody is offered this unless they ask for it. > - **Already on 2.9-pre1 or pre2?** This build carries the **same versionCode (49)** so it installs straight over them — but for that reason the in-app updater will **not** offer it to you automatically. Grab the APK below. > - **Coming from 2.8?** Settings → enable **"Include pre-releases"** in the updater, or just sideload. > - **If it misbehaves, install [2.8](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.8) back over the top.** It's app-side only, so nothing about your containers is at risk either way. > - **Please report what you find** — that's the entire point of this build. [Open an issue](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/new) with logs where you can. Like the last several releases this is **entirely app-side** — **no ImageFS reinstall**. Containers, themes, custom accent and per-game settings all carry over. Install straight over 2.8, pre1 or pre2. ## 🔁 What changed since 2.9-pre2 pre2 was cut two days ago. `main` has moved a long way since, and the controls editor has had another eleven commits of its own. ### 🎮 Controls editor — controller handling and custom icons *(by [@arro000](https://github.com/arro000))* - **Custom icon rendering options** — more control over how imported glyphs are drawn, plus a fix for paint state leaking between elements. - **Opt-in Button Grid multitouch** — press more than one cell of a grid at once, off by default. - **Controller input correctness** — momentary button edges are now tracked **per device**, pulses **per source**, and mappings dispatch on state *edges* rather than levels. If you had a controller that double-fired, dropped inputs when a second pad was connected, or left a button stuck, this is the area that changed. - **Bounded combos and a resized event buffer**, and deferred range-input callbacks are now cancelled properly. - Pulse state maps are reused rather than reallocated each frame. ### 🆕 Smart Game Import *(new on `main` since pre2)* Adding a game now tries to work out **what it actually is** instead of handing you the executable's filename. - **Automatic naming** from folder signals, PE version info, Steam and GOG id files — with names normalised (colons, ™/®, version tags and `-Win64-Shipping` suffixes stripped). - **Search Steam** confirmation dialog when the guess is uncertain, so you can pick the right title. - **Dependency detection** — the importer scans the game folder for bundled redistributables and **recommends the components it needs** as chips you can install in one tap, with bundled and optional split out. - Installer-based components now run **visibly on the container desktop** rather than silently, and return you to where you were afterwards. - **Game Details** editor, with the details shown on the loading screen. ### 🖥️ In-game refresh rates above 60 Hz *(new on `main` since pre2)* Games that expose a refresh-rate setting were **locked to 60 Hz on any panel**, and no client-side setting could change it — the cause was on our side. Our X server implemented BigReq, DRI3, MIT-SHM, Present and Sync but **no RandR at all**, which is how Wine enumerates display modes; finding none, it fell back to a single synthetic 60 Hz mode. - The X server now implements **RandR**, and advertises the rates your panel actually supports. - **Max in-game refresh rate** — a ceiling, as a container default and a per-game override, for when you'd rather a game didn't reach for 144. - This is a **different axis** from the existing match/manual refresh settings: those drive the host Android panel, this bounds what the guest game may request. > ### ✅ Tested and verified — but you need a current Wine layer > > **This only works on a Proton layer whose `winex11` was compiled with xrandr** — the refreshed **Proton 11.0-1** and **Proton 10.0-4** builds, both downloadable in-app. On an older layer the app detects the missing capability and deliberately leaves the unlock off, so nothing regresses; you simply won't get the extra rates until you download one of those two. > > Restart the game after changing a cap — engines read the mode list only at startup. ### 🎞️ Frame generation - **A fifth model, "FSR3+"** — model 3's optical flow reworked with a **per-block search** (instead of per-pixel), a **5×5 window**, **sub-pixel refinement** and **true bidirectional flow with occlusion gating**, for roughly **2.7× less cost** than model 3. Model 3 is kept bit-identical so the two can be compared directly. - **The per-frame present stall is gone.** The layer was calling `vkQueueWaitIdle` on the compute queue once per presented frame — which, on any GPU exposing a single universal queue family (the normal Adreno layout), was draining *the game's own* in-flight work, not just the interpolation dispatch. It now waits on the dispatch's own fence. *The present-path fix is from **[@clintOnSky](https://github.com/clintOnSky)**'s [#96](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/96) — the Xiaomi half of that PR shipped in pre2, this is the other half. Thank you.* > ### ✅ Tested and verified working — but still experimental > > Frame generation runs, the models switch live, and the present-path fix is in. **That is not the same as it being finished.** bionic-fg remains **experimental, work-in-progress and quirky** — expect odd behaviour in places, particularly around interactions with the FPS limiter and in fast motion. > > **FSR3 and FSR3+ are still unproven for image quality specifically.** The published FSR3 numbers were measured while parked, which is a fair cost measurement and a worthless quality one. Fast lateral motion and occlusion edges are exactly where they might fall apart — that's the test that's still wanted, and the most useful thing you can report back. ### 📦 Also - **GameNative wrapper 20260723** bundled. - Fixed a **crash opening the new-container editor** introduced by the refresh work. ## 🕹️ Virtual controls editor — rebuilt in Compose *(in progress)* Unchanged in scope from pre1 and pre2, with the fixes above folded in. The whole on-screen controls editor has been rewritten, replacing the old Fragment/XML settings interface with a Compose one — and a large set of new capabilities along with it. - **New control types** — **Dynamic Stick**, **Mouse Area**, **Button Grid**, **Expandable Button**, and an **Android Keyboard** control. - **A real editing UI** — Compose toolbar, visual control-type picker, and a sliding settings panel that opens automatically when you add an element. - **Per-element tuning** — dead zones for Stick / Dynamic Stick / D-Pad, sensitivity, hold bindings, detection-area styling and grid cell shapes. - **Better bindings** — category-filtered binding selector, **multi-key combos**, binding presets, and custom icons. - **Control groups** — name a group, toggle its visibility, and move its members together. - **Reference background images** with adjustable opacity, so you can lay controls out against a screenshot of the actual game. - **Live in-game profile editing** — adjust a profile without leaving the Wine session. - **Versioned ICPx import/export** — embedded icons, legacy `.icp` compatibility, validation and atomic writes. - **Input hardening** — fixes for stuck and conflicting buttons, sticks, and duplicate bindings. > ⚠️ **This is still the part that most needs testing.** It is a very large change to the input system, it is **not yet merged**, and it has not had a full review. Please exercise your existing control profiles and report anything that regressed — especially profiles created in an older version. *This work is entirely by **[@arro000](https://github.com/arro000)** in **[PR #156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)**, published here as a test build so it can get device coverage before merge. Thank you.* ## 🐞 Known issues - **Occasional ANR ("Bannerlator isn't responding") during input.** The UI thread can block on a socket write and stall touch delivery for 5+ seconds. **This is pre-existing** — it reproduces on 2.8 and earlier — but you may well meet it while testing, so it's listed rather than left as a surprise. Reports with a timestamp are still useful. - **The FPS limiter and frame generation interact badly at low caps.** With a cap around 30 and generation on, generated frames get dropped and you end up with fewer frames than you asked for. Understood and being worked on; a cap of 60 behaves correctly. Not a regression from pre2. - **Frame generation is verified working, but bionic-fg as a whole is still experimental / work-in-progress and quirky.** Models 1–4 in particular are not quality-proven. Default (model 0) is unchanged from 2.8. - **The refresh-rate unlock needs a current Wine layer.** It's verified working, but only on the refreshed **Proton 11.0-1** or **Proton 10.0-4** layers (both in the in-app downloads). On anything older it stays off by design. - The virtual controls editor is **unmerged, in-progress work**. Treat anything it does as provisional. ## 📥 Downloads | Variant | File | |---|---| | **Standard** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre3-standard.apk` | | **PUBG** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre3-pubg.apk` | | **Ludashi** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre3-ludashi.apk` | > ℹ️ **On pre1 or pre2 already?** Same versionCode, so the in-app updater won't prompt you — download directly from here and install over the top. **On 2.8?** Turn on **"Include pre-releases"** in the updater, or sideload. Either way this build is **entirely app-side**: there's **no ImageFS reinstall**, and your containers, themes, accent, per-game settings and control colours all carry over. ## 🙏 Credits - **[@arro000](https://github.com/arro000)** — the entire virtual controls editor rebuild ([#156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)): the Compose editor, the new control types, per-element tuning, control groups, background images, live in-game profile editing and the ICPx format — and, in this build, the custom-icon rendering work, Button Grid multitouch and the per-device controller input fixes. - **[@clintOnSky](https://github.com/clintOnSky)** — the frame-gen present-path fix ([#96](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/96)) that removes a per-frame stall on the game's own render queue, following the Xiaomi/HyperOS fix from the same PR that shipped in pre2. - **[@Devaspe](https://github.com/Devaspe)** — continued testing of the pre-release line, and confirming the Xiaomi/HyperOS frame-gen fix on real hardware.

releases.name: Bannerlator 2.9-pre2 (superseded by 2.9-pre3)
releases.body:
> # ⛔ Superseded — please use [2.9-pre3](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.9-pre3) > > **This build is no longer the current test build.** [**2.9-pre3**](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.9-pre3) replaces it and is what you want if you're testing the virtual controls editor. > > pre3 carries everything below **plus** eleven further controls-editor commits from [@arro000](https://github.com/arro000) (per-device controller edges, custom icon rendering, Button Grid multitouch), **Smart Game Import**, the **in-game refresh-rate unlock**, a fifth frame-gen model (**FSR3+**) and the removal of a per-frame present stall. > > It's the **same versionCode (49)**, so it installs straight over this one — but the in-app updater won't prompt you. Download it from the [pre3 page](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.9-pre3). > > *This release is kept for reference only. Bug reports against it are still welcome, but please check whether pre3 already fixes them first.* ---

     

# Bannerlator 2.9-pre2 — test build > ### ⚠️ This is a pre-release, not a stable build > It exists so the work below can get real testing on real devices. **Expect rough edges.** The headline feature — the rebuilt virtual controls editor — is still **in-progress work from an open pull request that hasn't been merged or fully reviewed yet**. > > - **Stable users are not affected.** `2.8` remains the Latest release; nobody is offered this unless they ask for it. > - **Already on 2.9-pre1?** This build carries the **same versionCode (49)** so it installs straight over pre1 — but for that reason the in-app updater will **not** offer it to you automatically. Grab the APK below. > - **Coming from 2.8?** Settings → enable **"Include pre-releases"** in the updater, or just sideload. > - **If it misbehaves, install [2.8](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.8) back over the top.** It's app-side only, so nothing about your containers is at risk either way. > - **Please report what you find** — that's the entire point of this build. [Open an issue](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/new) with logs where you can. Like the last several releases this is **entirely app-side** — **no ImageFS reinstall**. Containers, themes, custom accent and per-game settings all carry over. Install straight over 2.8 or pre1. ## 🔁 What changed since 2.9-pre1 pre1 was cut to get the controls editor tested. Everything that came back has been acted on, and the build has been rebased onto current `main`, which has moved a long way in two days. **Controls editor — every reported item fixed** *(thanks [@Devaspe](https://github.com/Devaspe))* - **D-Pad highlighting** — pressing the D-Pad now highlights it, and holding it while pressing another button no longer freezes it lit. - **Expandable Button labels** now shorten the same way the rest do (`BUTTON A` → `A`), so they fit their cells. - **Imported icons are themed** — custom PNG and SVG glyphs now take the app accent colour like the built-in ones, instead of rendering untinted. SVG import and a size cap came with it. - **Binding category filters wrap properly**, so `keyboard` / `gamepad` / `mouse` no longer spill letters onto a second line. - Plus virtual-mouse priority handling and button-grid sizing/alignment work from [@arro000](https://github.com/arro000)'s own testing. **And a merge-only bug that existed in neither branch alone** — `releaseAllInputs()` cleared the finger state out from under the Cursor-to-Touch gesture machine, which could fire a queued long-press against a finger that had just been released. Fixed on both sides now. ## ✨ Also new since 2.8 — everything merged to `main` since pre1 ### 🎞️ Frame generation — four interpolation models, switchable live The bundled bionic-fg layer had been unchanged since June and was missing every engine built since. It's now current, and you can pick between four motion-estimation models — **Default**, **Traced**, **V2** and **FSR3** — per container, per game, or live from the in-game drawer while the game is running. - **Default** stays the default, so nothing changes unless you go looking. - On an Adreno 750 test, **FSR3 measured ~45% more frames than Default while using less GPU** — but it is **experimental and unproven for image quality**, particularly in fast lateral motion. Labelled as such in the UI. Feedback on how the models compare on *your* device and games is exactly what's wanted. **Two silent bugs fixed alongside it:** bundled frame-gen layers were never actually reaching devices on an app update — only on a full ImageFS reinstall — and staging compared file size alone, so a same-size update was skipped forever. Both fixed, so layer updates now arrive with the app. ### 📱 Frame generation now works on Xiaomi / HyperOS On HyperOS, **neither** frame-gen engine loaded at all — frame generation silently did nothing for every Xiaomi user. A `libjpeg` symlink in our ImageFS was aborting the layer load outright. It's now moved aside on affected devices only; everything else is untouched. *Diagnosed and fixed by **[@clintOnSky](https://github.com/clintOnSky)** ([#96](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/96)), reported by **[@Shalaykin1](https://github.com/Shalaykin1)** ([#40](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/40)), and confirmed working on real HyperOS hardware by **[@Devaspe](https://github.com/Devaspe)**. Thank you all.* ### 💾 Storage and drives - **SD cards are always listed** in the file manager — volumes now come from the framework rather than a `/storage` scan. - **One drive entry per volume** instead of one per path. - **Container drives use the in-app picker**, and duplicate drive letters are rejected instead of silently colliding. ### 🌡️ Performance HUD - **Temperature colour bands** driven by the device's own thermal trip points, so amber and red mean something on *your* hardware rather than a guessed threshold. - **°C / °F toggle.** ### ⚙️ Environment variables - The legacy env-vars editor has been **rebuilt in Compose** and is now shared across the app, with **editable SELECT comboboxes** and **collapsible chip groups**. ## 🕹️ Virtual controls editor — rebuilt in Compose *(in progress)* Unchanged in scope from pre1, with the fixes above folded in. The whole on-screen controls editor has been rewritten, replacing the old Fragment/XML settings interface with a Compose one — and a large set of new capabilities along with it. - **New control types** — **Dynamic Stick**, **Mouse Area**, **Button Grid**, **Expandable Button**, and an **Android Keyboard** control. - **A real editing UI** — Compose toolbar, visual control-type picker, and a sliding settings panel that opens automatically when you add an element. - **Per-element tuning** — dead zones for Stick / Dynamic Stick / D-Pad, sensitivity, hold bindings, detection-area styling and grid cell shapes. - **Better bindings** — category-filtered binding selector, **multi-key combos**, binding presets, and custom icons. - **Control groups** — name a group, toggle its visibility, and move its members together. - **Reference background images** with adjustable opacity, so you can lay controls out against a screenshot of the actual game. - **Live in-game profile editing** — adjust a profile without leaving the Wine session. - **Versioned ICPx import/export** — embedded icons, legacy `.icp` compatibility, validation and atomic writes. - **Input hardening** — fixes for stuck and conflicting buttons, sticks, and duplicate bindings. > ⚠️ **This is still the part that most needs testing.** It is a very large change to the input system, it is **not yet merged**, and it has not had a full review. Please exercise your existing control profiles and report anything that regressed — especially profiles created in an older version. *This work is entirely by **[@arro000](https://github.com/arro000)** in **[PR #156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)**, published here as a test build so it can get device coverage before merge. Thank you.* ## 🖱️ Cursor to Touch — fixed, and given real gestures Carried over from pre1. **Cursor to Touch** (in-game drawer → **Controls → Mouse**) moves the pointer to wherever your finger lands, with **drag to box-select**, **hold for right click** (adjustable 150–800 ms, with a haptic tick) and **two-finger scroll**. The toggle-never-lit and lost-on-launch bugs are fixed. *Gesture set modeled on the RTS touch controls in [Producdevity/gamehub-lite](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite) **[#73](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/pull/73)** by **[@Nightwalker743](https://github.com/Nightwalker743)** — the behaviour and thresholds are theirs; the implementation here is written against Bannerlator's own touch path. Thank you.* ## 🐞 Known issues - **Occasional ANR ("Bannerlator isn't responding") during input.** The UI thread can block on a socket write and stall touch delivery for 5+ seconds. **This is pre-existing** — it reproduces on 2.8 and earlier — but you may well meet it while testing, so it's listed rather than left as a surprise. Reports with a timestamp are still useful. - **The FPS limiter and frame generation interact badly at low caps.** With a cap around 30 and generation on, generated frames get dropped and you end up with fewer frames than you asked for. Understood and being worked on; a cap of 60 behaves correctly. Not a regression from pre1. - **Frame-gen models 1–3 are experimental** and not quality-proven. Default (model 0) is unchanged from 2.8. - The virtual controls editor is **unmerged, in-progress work**. Treat anything it does as provisional. ## 📥 Downloads | Variant | File | |---|---| | **Standard** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre2-standard.apk` | | **PUBG** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre2-pubg.apk` | | **Ludashi** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre2-ludashi.apk` | > ℹ️ **On pre1 already?** Same versionCode, so the in-app updater won't prompt you — download directly from here and install over the top. **On 2.8?** Turn on **"Include pre-releases"** in the updater, or sideload. Either way this build is **entirely app-side**: there's **no ImageFS reinstall**, and your containers, themes, accent, per-game settings and control colours all carry over. ## 🙏 Credits - **[@arro000](https://github.com/arro000)** — the entire virtual controls editor rebuild ([#156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)): the Compose editor, the new control types, per-element tuning, control groups, background images, live in-game profile editing and the ICPx format — and the fixes in this build responding to pre1 feedback. - **[@Devaspe](https://github.com/Devaspe)** — detailed testing of pre1 and the four editor reports fixed here, plus confirming the Xiaomi/HyperOS frame-gen fix on real hardware. - **[@clintOnSky](https://github.com/clintOnSky)** — diagnosing and fixing the Xiaomi `libjpeg` bug that stopped both frame-gen layers loading on HyperOS ([#96](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/96)). - **[@Shalaykin1](https://github.com/Shalaykin1)** — reporting that frame generation was dead on HyperOS 3 ([#40](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/40)), which is exactly the bug fixed here. - **[@Nightwalker743](https://github.com/Nightwalker743)** and **[Producdevity/gamehub-lite](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite)** — the RTS touch-control design ([#73](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/pull/73)) the Cursor to Touch gestures follow.

releases.name: Bannerlator 2.8
releases.body:
# Bannerlator 2.8 Run Windows apps and games on Android — no PC and no root required. **2.8 is a feature release built around three big additions: gyroscope motion aim, a completely rebuilt Big Picture mode, and PC-accurate controller vibration.** Aim by **tilting your device** — gyro drives the right stick, left stick or the mouse, in Rate or Tilt-to-Aim mode, with Hold-or-Toggle activation, real drift calibration, and settings saved per game. **Big Picture** is rebuilt from scratch in Compose as a fluid couch launcher with full D-pad navigation and no background music. **Rumble now behaves like it does on a PC** — dual-motor, per-container mode and intensity, and a winebus patch so sustained rumble actually sustains. The in-game **Controls drawer** is reorganised into Touch / Mouse / Vibration / Gyro sub-tabs. Like the last several releases it's **entirely app-side** — **no ImageFS reinstall** — your containers, themes, custom accent and per-game settings all carry over untouched. Just install over 2.7.1.
✨ Full feature list — click to expand everything Bannerlator offers Everything the app offers, at a glance. **🍷 Windows compatibility** - **Wine** — run native Win32/Win64 apps & games. - **Box64 / Box86** x86(-64)→ARM translation with performance presets. - **WOWBox64** for arm64ec containers. - **FEXCore** alt x86/x64 backend, with automatic unixlib (`.so`) matching per version. - **arm64ec** and **x64** container support. **🎨 Graphics & translation layers** - 📖 **[Which wrapper/driver for my device? →](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/blob/main/docs/graphics-wrappers-guide.md)** - **DXVK** (DX8/9/10/11→Vulkan; GPLAsync & Sarek variants). - **VKD3D-Proton** (DX12→Vulkan). - **WineD3D / DirectDraw** OpenGL fallback for older titles. - **Proton bionic** layers (via GameNative) — **Proton 11.0-1** & **Proton 10.0-4** (arm64ec; FEX-unixlib + fast-yield), per-SDK (28 / 35). - **VEGAS** — Adreno-optimized DXVK (less stutter, real-time upscaling). - **Turnip / Mesa** Adreno drivers (+timeline-semaphore patches), bundled and installable. - **Wrapper Version Manager** *(new)* — bring your own graphics wrapper (`.tzst`): import / update / delete, a curated **downloadable catalog** from across the Winlator family, and **auto-detected settings** for every wrapper (controls read straight from what the wrapper actually supports). - **BCn transcoding for Mali / Xclipse** — "Wrapper + bcn_layer" driver + BCn settings panel. - **Mali DX12 (experimental)** — opt-in **"Wrapper + compat + bcn"** driver (leegao BCn + DX12 compat layer) with a **GameNative-engine** toggle, for Valhall-class Mali. **🖥️ Renderers** - **Vulkan / OpenGL / SurfaceFlinger / VirGL** host renderers. - **SurfaceFlinger colour fix** — R/B-swap + crash fix, per-container/game toggle. - **Native Rendering (Low-Latency Mode)** — direct-scanout, cuts input lag (Vulkan & OpenGL). - **Spatial upscalers** — SGSR, FSR / FSR-Fit, NIS, Sharpen (RCAS), Linear / Nearest; live in-game, saved per game. - **Fullscreen aspect modes** — Off / Fit / Stretch / Fill / Integer, live switch, per game. - **Supersampling** — 1.25× / 1.5× / 2× render scale, Lanczos-2 downsample. - **Screen effects** (Vulkan & OpenGL) — FXAA, Toon, CRT, NTSC, colour grading, CAS, fake-HDR. - **Debanding (Vulkan)** — adjustable dither pass for smooth gradients. - **ReShade** — real `.fx` effects on DXVK / VKD3D, on-device compile, ~100-effect catalog + your own, live in-game tab, per game, solo or stacked. - **VRR** — match refresh to FPS (Auto or 60 / 90 / 120 / 144 Hz), all three renderers. - Adjustable resolution & frame-rate limit. **🎞️ Frame generation & pacing** - **Two engines** — Off / **bionic-fg** (bundled) / **lsfg-vk** (bring your own `Lossless.dll`), shown as a badge in-game. - **Live controls** — Off / 2× / 3× / 4× + flow-scale slider, hot-reloaded. - **Standalone FPS limiter** — engine-independent present-pacing cap with quick 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 presets; steps aside when lsfg multiplies; both renderers. - **lsfg Performance mode** — a lighter frame-gen model for weaker GPUs; per-container and live in-game, no root required. **📦 Containers** - Multiple isolated Wine containers with redesigned spec-chip cards. - **Run as administrator** (per-container toggle) for installers/games needing elevation. - **Auto-close on game exit** (per-container toggle). - **Import / export** containers. - Per-container Wine / driver / DXVK / VKD3D / Box64 / drives / Z-drive / env-vars, with env-var **presets**. - **Desktop wallpaper picker** (per-container or global). - **Compatibility Layers download menu** — browse / install / remove every component with progress bars, continuing in the background. **🕹️ Games, shortcuts & input** - Game library (grid / list, sort, filters) with redesigned cards. - Add shortcuts from storage; **back up / restore saves** (GameHub-compatible zips). - **SteamGridDB** cover scraping; per-game language / locale. - **On-screen touch controls** (theme-follow or per-game colour) + virtual gamepads. - **Physical controllers** (SDL2) + touchpad / mouse emulation; rebuilt binding screen. - **PC-accurate vibration** — dual-motor rumble, per-container mode + intensity, winebus never-expire duration patch; per-slot **and master** toggles. - **Gyroscope motion aim** — right-stick or mouse output, Tilt-to-Aim orientation mode, Hold/Toggle activation, device calibration, saved per container and per game. **🌐 Community Configs** - **Catalog browser** (globe) with search, filters, sort, and "Matches my device". - **One-tap Apply** — surgically merges just that config's settings, preserving the rest. - **Smart install** of a config's missing DXVK / VKD3D / FEXCore / Turnip, then auto-applies. - **Config detail** — provenance, what-it-sets, before-apply diff, upvotes / downloads / comments. - **Share your own** — export the full recipe (never your files, logins or tuning), anonymous by default; **My uploads** to edit / delete. - **Optional account** (username + password, recovery-key, no email) so uploads follow you and carry your name — everything works anonymously without it. - **Read-only for your setup** — nothing changes unless you tap Apply. **🛒 Built-in stores & cross-store Download Manager** - **Steam** — user/pass or QR, owned library, built-in depot engine (JavaSteam), 4-tier speed, session hardening, DLC picker, true-size fix, optional **Goldberg** patch. - **Epic / Amazon** — sign in, browse, download / install / launch (incl. Epic free games). - **GOG** — DRM-free library with cloud-save sync. - **⬇ Cross-store Download Manager** — one view of all downloads + installed library, live progress, background + shade notifications, launch / verified uninstall. **🔒 Security & your store accounts** - Third-party sign-ins (not affiliated with the stores) — **use at your own risk**. - **Credentials redacted from logs** — signed URLs, OAuth codes, GOG secret / refresh-token, account IDs — in logcat and shareable files. **🧰 Bundled Start-menu utilities** - **[Banner File Manager](https://github.com/The412Banner/banner-file-manager)** *(1.1.0 — dual-pane split view, Open-as-admin, native Win32 copy)*, **AIO Graphics Test**, **Game Controller Test**; `.lnk` "Start in" working-directory support. **🎛️ Interface & in-game overlay** - **Jetpack Compose** UI with an icon-led drawer; your theme recolours the whole app *and* the in-game drawer. - **16 themes** + HSV custom-accent picker. - **Big Picture mode** — Compose couch launcher, full D-pad navigation, rails to games / settings / features, per-game spec chips. - In-game overlay drawer + Task Manager (works on any renderer); Controls split into **Touch / Mouse / Vibration / Gyro** sub-tabs. - **File Manager with Favorites** — storage-badged, real thumbnails, doubles as the universal import picker. - **Performance HUD — three overlay styles** (Classic / GameHub / GameNative-style with live graphs), one shared FPS source + device-complete metrics (FPS / frame time / CPU-GPU load & temp / RAM / battery / power), accent outline, position saved per game. - **FEX runtime indicator** — live arm64ec vs x86-64, translator, and unixlib vs DLL. **📥 Builds & distribution** - Three flavors (standard / PuBG / Ludashi), optimized release builds, AOSP-testkey signed, GitHub Actions CI + tagged releases.
## ✨ What's New in 2.8 ### 🎯 Gyroscope — motion aim Aim by **tilting your device**. Gyro input can drive the **right stick**, the **left stick** or the **mouse**, in either of two modes: **Rate** (how fast you're turning — feels like a mouse, stops when you stop) or **Tilt to Aim** (the angle you're holding — a held tilt keeps aiming). - **Hold or Toggle activation** — hold a button while you tilt, or flip it on and leave it on. - **Device-level calibration** in the app's Input Controls screen, plus a live bias correction — so a device that drifts sitting on a table doesn't drift in-game. - **Saved per container and per game**, like the rest of the presets. - **Gyro-mouse drives the X pointer directly**, so motion control works on a Wine container desktop, not only in captured mouse-look games. - **Choose your activator** — L1 / L2 / R1 / R3, or Always On, plus adjustable **sensitivity, deadzone, smoothing and axis invert**. > 📖 **[Read the complete gyro guide →](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/blob/main/docs/gyro-controls-guide.md)** — every mode and setting explained in plain English: Rate vs Tilt to Aim, which target to pick, Hold vs Toggle, how to tune it, how to kill drift, and troubleshooting. *Modeled on [WinNative](https://github.com/WinNative-Emu/WinNative)'s rate-mode gyro implementation — thank you.* ### 📺 Big Picture — rebuilt from scratch Big Picture mode is now a **full Compose rebuild** — a fluid couch launcher you can actually drive from the sofa. - **Direct rails to your games, settings and features** — no more hunting through menus with a D-pad. - **Real per-game spec chips** showing what each title is actually set to (renderer · DXVK · driver · frame-gen), sized so the full spec fits without clipping. - **No background music.** - **D-pad navigation fixed throughout** — no phantom focus rings, no clipped Play buttons, no hero buttons overflowing on long game titles. ### 🎮 PC-accurate controller vibration Rumble now behaves the way it does on a PC. - **Dual-motor output** — the strong and weak motors are driven independently instead of being collapsed into one flat buzz. - **Per-container vibration mode and intensity.** - **Sustained rumble actually sustains** — a `winebus` duration patch stops SDL rumble from auto-expiring mid-effect (it used to die after about a second). Applied across **Proton 10 and 11**, on both **arm64ec and x86-64**, with a build-agnostic structural fallback so it keeps working on future layers. *The vibration feature originates from [GameNative](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative) **#1214**, reaching this build via [TideGear](https://github.com/TideGear/GameHub-Vibration-Fix)'s port and their preload-free `winebus` duration patch (**#91**), adopted with permission.* ### 🕹️ In-game Controls drawer The Controls tab is split into **Touch / Mouse / Vibration / Gyro** sub-tabs instead of one long scroll, and the toggle chips are now a uniform 3-across grid with shorter labels and centred short rows. ### 📁 Banner File Manager 1.1.0 New containers ship the updated build, replacing 1.0.0.
Previously in 2.7.1 — wrapper catalog updates, frame-gen Performance mode, Banner File Manager ### 🧩 Wrapper Version Manager — smarter catalog + bundled updates - **Persistent "Installed ✓" and "Update available" badges** — the catalog now remembers what you've installed across restarts and flags when a newer version exists, with **one-tap Update**. A **"From catalog"** chip marks catalog-installed wrappers in the manager. - **Bundled wrappers get updates too** — built-in wrappers now show real version labels (not "Unknown"), and a bundled slot lights up **"Update available"** when its catalog entry has a newer build — updatable in one tap, no app release needed. - **GameNative wrapper refreshed** to their latest July build (adds 32-bit game support). - **Bundled Mali layers on leegao's latest** — the leegao **BCn transcode** and **DX12 compat** layers ship with leegao's **layer-composition fix**, so the two stack correctly together (fixes device-hook propagation when both are active). - **Fixes** — the BCn layer (leegao) entry now detects correctly (was "Vulkan ICD" / 0 settings → **BCn layer / 13 knobs**); the shared "Extra libraries" payload is hidden from the manager (it isn't a wrapper); card text no longer truncates; and the catalog's Installed mark now clears properly on **Reset**. ### 🎞️ Frame generation — Performance mode (lsfg) A new **"Performance mode"** toggle for lsfg-vk frame generation — per-container in settings **and** live in the in-game drawer. It switches to a lighter frame-gen model for a real FPS gain on weaker GPUs, **with no root or read-only file hacks**. Defaults off. *(Thanks [@Tony57319](https://github.com/Tony57319) — [#152](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/152).)* ### 🎮 Controllers — vibration control - **New "Controller vibration" master switch** in the in-game Vibration section — one tap silences **all** rumble regardless of slot, saved globally. - **Fixed** the per-slot vibration toggles that snapped back instead of reflecting your changes. ### 📁 Banner File Manager (replaces WFM) New containers now ship **[Banner File Manager](https://github.com/The412Banner/banner-file-manager)** — our own native Win32 file manager, forked from [BrunoSX's Winlator File Manager](https://github.com/brunodev85/wfm): **dual-pane split view**, **Open as administrator / Open with**, **native Win32 copy** that sidesteps the Proton 10.0-4 shell32 copy-paste crash, byte-accurate copy progress with cancel, and light/dark theming. ### 🎨 Interface - **Consistent menu styling everywhere** — every dropdown / overflow menu now uses the same outlined-card look (dividers + accent icons) as the File Manager.
## 🌐 Community — thank you 🙏 Everything you've shared **directly to Bannerlator's own Community Config repo** now adds up to:

   

And because the in-app browser **also merges the BannerHub catalog**, the full set you can browse and one-tap-apply *inside the app* is bigger still — thousands of games and configs. **249 games** and **291 configs** shared straight to Bannerlator by the community — and thousands more usable in-app once the BannerHub catalog is merged in. All of it growing. Every config you share, every game you add, every account that joins makes this better for the next person. **This project grows *only* because of the community's support and participation — thank you.** - 📦 **Bannerlator config repo** — [github.com/The412Banner/bannerlator-game-configs](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerlator-game-configs) - 📦 **BannerHub catalog** (also browsable in-app) — [github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-game-configs](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-game-configs) - 🌐 **Browse online** — [the412banner.github.io/bannerlator-game-configs](https://the412banner.github.io/bannerlator-game-configs/) ## 📥 Downloads | Variant | File | |---|---| | **Standard** | `Bannerlator-2.8-standard.apk` | | **PUBG** | `Bannerlator-2.8-pubg.apk` | | **Ludashi** | `Bannerlator-2.8-ludashi.apk` | > ℹ️ **Updating in-app?** 2.8 is **entirely app-side** — the standard APK covers everything. There's **no ImageFS reinstall**: your containers, themes, custom accent, per-game settings and control colours all carry over. Just install over 2.7.1. ## 📖 Guides - 🎨 **[Graphics wrappers & drivers — which one should I use? →](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/blob/main/docs/graphics-wrappers-guide.md)** — what a wrapper actually does, a **pick-by-GPU table** (Adreno / Mali / Xclipse / PowerVR), every built-in driver explained, all **18 catalog wrappers** with their upstream authors — and which of them are **byte-identical across projects**, so you don't test the same file twice. - 🎯 **[Gyroscope (motion aim) — the complete guide →](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/blob/main/docs/gyro-controls-guide.md)** — Rate vs Tilt to Aim, which target to pick, Hold vs Toggle, tuning, drift calibration and troubleshooting. - 🌐 **[Community Configs — plain-English guide →](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/blob/main/docs/community-configs-guide.md)** — browsing, applying and sharing per-game setups, and the optional account.
🙏 Credits — click to expand: everyone this build stands on - **[WinNative](https://github.com/WinNative-Emu/WinNative)** — the reference for the new **gyroscope (motion aim)** support. Their rate-mode gyro implementation is what ours derives from: the sensor→stick pipeline (deadzone → sensitivity → exponential low-pass → clamp), the axis and sign conventions, and the fractional-remainder accumulator that keeps slow tilts from rounding away to nothing. Bannerlator adapted it to our evdev gamepad-injection path and extended the gyro-mouse mode to drive the X pointer directly. GPL-3.0, same as this project. Thank you. - **[TideGear](https://github.com/TideGear/GameHub-Vibration-Fix)** — the **PC-accurate controller vibration** this release's rumble is built on. TideGear authored both halves: the vibration feature port (carrying [GameNative](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative) **#1214** forward) and the preload-free `winebus.so` **rumble-duration patch** (**#91**) that drops the `libevshim` `LD_PRELOAD` hook and byte-patches SDL's rumble duration to never auto-expire — which is what makes sustained rumble actually hold. Adopted with the author's permission; Bannerlator re-derived the patterns per Proton build and added a build-agnostic structural fallback. - **[leegao](https://github.com/leegao)** — the Mali BCn transcode layer (`bcn_layer`) and the DX12 **compat layer** (`compat_layer`) that power the new "Wrapper + compat + bcn" driver are leegao's work, built from their own CI — including the just-landed layer-composition fix. Huge thanks. - **[GameNative](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative)** — the GameNative wrapper is the engine behind the DX12 toggle, and Bannerlator's HUD, present path, FPS-limiter and SurfaceFlinger colour work build on GameNative's foundations — and the **PC-accurate vibration** feature originates from GameNative **#1214**. Thank you to the GameNative team. - **[WinlatorMali](https://github.com/GunaCharanTeja/WinlatorMali) (GunaCharanTeja / Charan)** — the **Wrapper Version Manager** is modeled on WinlatorMali's graphics-driver manager, introduced in [Winlator Mali Bionic 1.1](https://github.com/GunaCharanTeja/WinlatorMali/releases/tag/bionic-mali-1.1); a number of the catalog wrappers come from WinlatorMali too (each credited in-app). The feature was requested in [#132](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/132) by [@6ui99uhkllj](https://github.com/6ui99uhkllj) — thank you both. - **[BrunoSX](https://github.com/brunodev85)** — the bundled file manager is **[Banner File Manager](https://github.com/The412Banner/banner-file-manager)**, our fork of BrunoSX's [Winlator File Manager](https://github.com/brunodev85/wfm) (MIT), rebuilt with native Win32 file operations (sidestepping the Proton 10.0-4 shell32 crash), a dual-pane split view, and Open-as-administrator / Open-with. - **Recent reports & requests** — [@Tony57319](https://github.com/Tony57319) ([#152](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/152) — lsfg Performance mode) and [@6ui99uhkllj](https://github.com/6ui99uhkllj) ([#132](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/132) — Wrapper Version Manager), carried over from the 2.7 / 2.7.1 cycle. - **The wider stack** — built on the Winlator → cmod → Star Bionic lineage ([brunodev85](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator), [coffincolors](https://github.com/coffincolors/winlator), [Pipetto-crypto](https://github.com/Pipetto-crypto/winlator), [star-emu](https://github.com/star-emu/star)) with DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEXCore, [JavaSteam](https://github.com/Longi94/JavaSteam), and wrappers credited to their upstreams ([WinlatorMali](https://github.com/GunaCharanTeja/WinlatorMali), GameNative, leegao). Full attribution in the [repo README](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator#-credits).
## 🔗 Notes - **Banner File Manager** ships in **new containers** — it's installed from the container template at creation, so existing containers keep the previous file manager until recreated. - The **Mali DX12** driver (from 2.7) remains **experimental and opt-in** — inert unless you select it, and Qualcomm/Adreno devices are unaffected. DX12 on Mali is not yet fully proven on hardware; reports with logs are welcome. - **Gyroscope motion aim** needs a device with a gyroscope; on devices without one the gyro controls simply stay inert. - Nothing about your existing containers or settings changes on update — install over 2.7.1.

releases.name: Bannerlator 2.9-pre1
releases.body: # Bannerlator 2.9-pre1 — test build > ### ⚠️ This is a pre-release, not a stable build > It exists so the two changes below can get real testing on real devices. **Expect rough edges.** The headline feature — the rebuilt virtual controls editor — is **in-progress work from an open pull request that hasn't been merged or fully reviewed yet**. > > - **Stable users are not affected.** `2.8` remains the Latest release; nobody is offered this unless they ask for it. > - **To get it in-app:** Settings → enable **"Include pre-releases"** in the updater. Otherwise just sideload the APK below. > - **If it misbehaves, install [2.8](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.8) back over the top.** It's app-side only, so nothing about your containers is at risk either way. > - **Please report what you find** — that's the entire point of this build. [Open an issue](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/issues/new) with logs where you can. Like the last several releases this is **entirely app-side** — **no ImageFS reinstall**. Containers, themes, custom accent and per-game settings all carry over. Install straight over 2.8. ## ✨ What's in this build ### 🕹️ Virtual controls editor — rebuilt in Compose *(in progress)* The whole on-screen controls editor has been rewritten, replacing the old Fragment/XML settings interface with a Compose one — and a large set of new capabilities along with it. - **New control types** — **Dynamic Stick**, **Mouse Area**, **Button Grid**, **Expandable Button**, and an **Android Keyboard** control. - **A real editing UI** — Compose toolbar, visual control-type picker, and a sliding settings panel that opens automatically when you add an element. - **Per-element tuning** — dead zones for Stick / Dynamic Stick / D-Pad, sensitivity, hold bindings, detection-area styling and grid cell shapes. - **Better bindings** — category-filtered binding selector, **multi-key combos**, binding presets, and custom icons. - **Control groups** — name a group, toggle its visibility, and move its members together. - **Reference background images** with adjustable opacity, so you can lay controls out against a screenshot of the actual game. - **Live in-game profile editing** — adjust a profile without leaving the Wine session. - **Versioned ICPx import/export** — embedded icons, legacy `.icp` compatibility, validation and atomic writes. - **Input hardening** — fixes for stuck and conflicting buttons, sticks, and duplicate bindings. > ⚠️ **This is the part that most needs testing.** It is a very large change to the input system, it is **not yet merged**, and it has not had a full review. Please exercise your existing control profiles and report anything that regressed — especially profiles created in an older version. *This work is entirely by **[@arro000](https://github.com/arro000)** in **[PR #156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)**, published here as a test build so it can get device coverage before merge. Thank you.* ### 🖱️ Cursor to Touch — fixed, and given real gestures **Cursor to Touch** (in-game drawer → **Controls → Mouse**) moves the pointer to wherever your finger lands. Two long-standing bugs are fixed and the mode has been built out. **Fixes** - **The toggle never showed as on.** The chip stayed dark no matter how many times you tapped it, even though the mode was actually working — the drawer was reading a value nothing ever wrote to. - **The setting was silently lost on every launch.** The preference persisted, but was never re-applied when the touchpad view was created, so it quietly reverted to off each session until you toggled it again. - The three **Mouse** chips no longer close the drawer when tapped, so you can see the state change where you tapped it. **New gestures** — shown under the toggle whenever Cursor to Touch is on, each independently switchable, applied instantly and saved: - **Drag to box-select** — drag past the tap threshold and the left button is held while the cursor tracks your finger, giving you a real selection rectangle. This is what makes strategy, tactics and point-and-click games playable by touch. - **Hold for right click** — hold in place and the right button fires where your finger is, with an adjustable **150–800 ms** delay and a haptic tick so you can feel it land. - **Two-finger drag still scrolls the wheel**, which in most strategy games is your camera zoom. *Gesture set modeled on the RTS touch controls in [Producdevity/gamehub-lite](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite) **[#73](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/pull/73)** by **[@Nightwalker743](https://github.com/Nightwalker743)** — the behaviour and thresholds are theirs; the implementation here is written against Bannerlator's own touch path. Thank you.* ## 🐞 Known issues - **Occasional ANR ("Bannerlator isn't responding") during input.** The UI thread can block on a socket write and stall touch delivery for 5+ seconds. **This is pre-existing** — it reproduces on 2.8 and earlier, and is not caused by anything new here — but you may well meet it while testing, so it's listed rather than left as a surprise. Reports with a timestamp are still useful. - The virtual controls editor is **unmerged, in-progress work**. Treat anything it does as provisional. ## 📥 Downloads | Variant | File | |---|---| | **Standard** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre1-standard.apk` | | **PUBG** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre1-pubg.apk` | | **Ludashi** | `Bannerlator-2.9-pre1-ludashi.apk` | > ℹ️ **Updating in-app?** Turn on **"Include pre-releases"** in the updater — without it you'll stay on 2.8. This build is **entirely app-side**: there's **no ImageFS reinstall**, and your containers, themes, accent, per-game settings and control colours all carry over. Install over 2.8. ## 🙏 Credits - **[@arro000](https://github.com/arro000)** — the entire virtual controls editor rebuild ([#156](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/pull/156)): the Compose editor, the new control types, per-element tuning, control groups, background images, live in-game profile editing and the ICPx format. Published here as a test build with the work still in progress. - **[@Nightwalker743](https://github.com/Nightwalker743)** and **[Producdevity/gamehub-lite](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite)** — the RTS touch-control design ([#73](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/pull/73)) the Cursor to Touch gestures follow. - **Everything 2.8 stands on** — full credits in the [2.8 release notes](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.8) and the [repo README](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator#-credits). ## 🔗 Notes - **`2.8` is still the Latest release.** This pre-release is invisible to the default updater; only the "Include pre-releases" opt-in surfaces it. - Everything from **2.8** — gyro motion aim, the rebuilt Big Picture, PC-accurate vibration — is included here unchanged. See the **[2.8 release notes](https://github.com/The412Banner/Bannerlator/releases/tag/2.8)** for that feature list. - Nothing about your existing containers or settings changes on update.

releases.name: Bannerlator 2.7.1
releases.body:
# Bannerlator 2.7.1 Run Windows apps and games on Android — no PC and no root required. **2.7.1 builds on 2.7's Wrapper Version Manager with a big round of catalog + update improvements — plus new controls and a fresh file manager.** The wrapper catalog now **remembers what you've installed** and **flags when an update is available** (one tap to grab the newer build) — for imported *and* bundled wrappers. Frame generation gains a **Performance mode** toggle for weaker GPUs (no root needed), controllers get a **master vibration switch**, the old WFM is replaced by our own **Banner File Manager**, and every menu in the app now shares one clean style. Like the last several releases it's **entirely app-side** — **no ImageFS reinstall** — your containers, themes, custom accent and per-game settings all carry over untouched. Just install over 2.7.
✨ Full feature list — click to expand everything Bannerlator offers Everything the app offers, at a glance. **🍷 Windows compatibility** - **Wine** — run native Win32/Win64 apps & games. - **Box64 / Box86** x86(-64)→ARM translation with performance presets. - **WOWBox64** for arm64ec containers. - **FEXCore** alt x86/x64 backend, with automatic unixlib (`.so`) matching per version. - **arm64ec** and **x64** container support. **🎨 Graphics & translation layers** - **DXVK** (DX8/9/10/11→Vulkan; GPLAsync & Sarek variants). - **VKD3D-Proton** (DX12→Vulkan). - **WineD3D / DirectDraw** OpenGL fallback for older titles. - **Proton bionic** layers (via GameNative) — **Proton 11.0-1** & **Proton 10.0-4** (arm64ec; FEX-unixlib + fast-yield), per-SDK (28 / 35). - **VEGAS** — Adreno-optimized DXVK (less stutter, real-time upscaling). - **Turnip / Mesa** Adreno drivers (+timeline-semaphore patches; `turnip-26.1.0` as a direct ICD for Android 10 / pre-11). - **Wrapper Version Manager** *(new)* — bring your own graphics wrapper (`.tzst`): import / update / delete, a curated **downloadable catalog** from across the Winlator family, and **auto-detected settings** for every wrapper (controls read straight from what the wrapper actually supports). - **BCn transcoding for Mali / Xclipse** — "Wrapper + bcn_layer" driver + BCn settings panel. - **Mali DX12 (experimental)** — opt-in **"Wrapper + compat + bcn"** driver (leegao BCn + DX12 compat layer) with a **GameNative-engine** toggle, for Valhall-class Mali. **🖥️ Renderers** - **Vulkan / OpenGL / SurfaceFlinger / VirGL** host renderers. - **SurfaceFlinger colour fix** — R/B-swap + crash fix, per-container/game toggle. - **Native Rendering (Low-Latency Mode)** — direct-scanout, cuts input lag (Vulkan & OpenGL). - **Spatial upscalers** — SGSR, FSR / FSR-Fit, NIS, Sharpen (RCAS), Linear / Nearest; live in-game, saved per game. - **Fullscreen aspect modes** — Off / Fit / Stretch / Fill / Integer, live switch, per game. - **Supersampling** — 1.25× / 1.5× / 2× render scale, Lanczos-2 downsample. - **Screen effects** (Vulkan & OpenGL) — FXAA, Toon, CRT, NTSC, colour grading, CAS, fake-HDR. - **Debanding (Vulkan)** — adjustable dither pass for smooth gradients. - **ReShade** — real `.fx` effects on DXVK / VKD3D, on-device compile, ~100-effect catalog + your own, live in-game tab, per game, solo or stacked. - **VRR** — match refresh to FPS (Auto or 60 / 90 / 120 / 144 Hz), all three renderers. - Adjustable resolution & frame-rate limit. **🎞️ Frame generation & pacing** - **Two engines** — Off / **bionic-fg** (bundled) / **lsfg-vk** (bring your own `Lossless.dll`), shown as a badge in-game. - **Live controls** — Off / 2× / 3× / 4× + flow-scale slider, hot-reloaded. - **Standalone FPS limiter** — engine-independent present-pacing cap with quick 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 presets; steps aside when lsfg multiplies; both renderers. - **lsfg Performance mode** — a lighter frame-gen model for weaker GPUs; per-container and live in-game, no root required. **📦 Containers** - Multiple isolated Wine containers with redesigned spec-chip cards. - **Run as administrator** (per-container toggle) for installers/games needing elevation. - **Auto-close on game exit** (per-container toggle). - **Import / export** containers. - Per-container Wine / driver / DXVK / VKD3D / Box64 / drives / Z-drive / env-vars, with env-var **presets**. - **Desktop wallpaper picker** (per-container or global). - **Compatibility Layers download menu** — browse / install / remove every component with progress bars, continuing in the background. **🕹️ Games, shortcuts & input** - Game library (grid / list, sort, filters) with redesigned cards. - Add shortcuts from storage; **back up / restore saves** (GameHub-compatible zips). - **SteamGridDB** cover scraping; per-game language / locale. - **On-screen touch controls** (theme-follow or per-game colour) + virtual gamepads. - **Physical controllers** (SDL2) + touchpad / mouse emulation; rebuilt binding screen; per-slot **and master** controller-vibration toggles. **🌐 Community Configs** - **Catalog browser** (globe) with search, filters, sort, and "Matches my device". - **One-tap Apply** — surgically merges just that config's settings, preserving the rest. - **Smart install** of a config's missing DXVK / VKD3D / FEXCore / Turnip, then auto-applies. - **Config detail** — provenance, what-it-sets, before-apply diff, upvotes / downloads / comments. - **Share your own** — export the full recipe (never your files, logins or tuning), anonymous by default; **My uploads** to edit / delete. - **Optional account** (username + password, recovery-key, no email) so uploads follow you and carry your name — everything works anonymously without it. - **Read-only for your setup** — nothing changes unless you tap Apply. **🛒 Built-in stores & cross-store Download Manager** - **Steam** — user/pass or QR, owned library, built-in depot engine (JavaSteam), 4-tier speed, session hardening, DLC picker, true-size fix, optional **Goldberg** patch. - **Epic / Amazon** — sign in, browse, download / install / launch (incl.
